answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 6872 Country: OM Title: For men it is that we should cut hair from navel upto where.how down can we go is it necessary to trim starting from navel what if u dont have hair or hair is lighter less in number and u are afraid that it will be become more ) so what we should do? Question: aslam o alaikum For men it is that we should cut hair from navel upto where.how down can we go is it necessary to trim starting from navel what if u dont have hair or hair is lighter less in number and u are afraid that it will be become more ) so what we should do? Answer ID: 6872 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1272/1195=D/1429) It is necessary to shave the hair below navel from abdomen to the penis and testicles and adjacent area which may be smeared during excretion and the hair around the anus. It is necessary to shave from below the navel. If there is hair it should be shaved. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
